title: Equipment Change Control Initiation: Servo Motor Retrofits
description: Intermediate pharmaceutical engineering module investigating equipment change control initiation: servo motor retrofits.
learning_objectives: Master professional Formal Justification Connectors in pharmaceutical engineering and cleanroom automation
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in equipment change control initiation: servo motor retrofits
Demonstrate precision in GAMP 5, CSV, and regulatory inspection compliance

questions.prompt: All sterile filling equipment parts _____ according to validated SOP-ENG-204 prior to batch compounding.

explanations.correct: Passive construction with modal: 'must be autoclaved'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' takes bare infinitive.
explanations.wrong_C: 'must autoclave' is active voice; parts do not autoclave themselves.
explanations.wrong_D: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: GxP SOP phrasing strictly requires passive voice with modals: 'must be autoclaved' (musí být autoklávovány).
